title: Module 3 — Pricing & commercial logic output
description: Output envelope of 03-pricing-commercial-logic. Numbers are in the client's currency, rounded to 2 decimals. Percentages are fractions (0.15 == 15%).

subtotal.description: materials_cost + sum(hours * rate), before risk/margin/discount multipliers.

priced_categories.description: Optional. Labour categories actually priced for this request (after scope filtering). Categories out of scope are omitted from the quote.

lines.description: Per-line breakdown feeding the proposal's price table. `sell_amount` values sum EXACTLY to `total` (per-line rounding residue is absorbed by the largest line). Module 4 renders sell_amount, never amount: `amount` is the pre-margin cost basis and the document is forwarded to the end customer.

category.description: Cost category, or 'materials' for the materials line.

amount.description: Internal cost basis (hours * rate, or materials_cost). Sums to `subtotal`.

sell_amount.description: Customer-facing price: amount scaled by (1+risk)(1+margin)(1-discount). Sums to `total`.
